item.title: Unwinding After Carnival: Trinidad’s March Eco-Adventures
item.description: Experience the best eco-adventures in Trinidad after Carnival with breathtaking hiking trails, waterfall excursions, turtle watching, and wildlife encounters. From the Caroni Swamp's Scarlet Ibis to the lush Northern Range waterfalls and the caves of Gasparee, unwind in nature's paradise. Explore Chaguaramas, Nariva Swamp, and Matura Beach for an unforgettable eco-tourism getaway.

item.title: Things to Do in Trinidad in May 2025
item.description: As May rolls on, Trinidad serves up a vibrant lineup of festivals, tours, concerts, and cultural experiences perfect for every kind of traveler. Whether you're into nature, food, music, or family fun, these upcoming events from May 17 onward offer plenty of reasons to explore the island. Mark your calendars and get ready to dive into the heart of Trinidad’s late-May magic.

item.title: Indian Arrival Day 2025: Celebrating 180 Years of Heritage in Trinidad
item.description: While Indian Arrival Day is officially observed on May 30, the celebrations extend into the weekend, offering a variety of events that honor Indo-Trinidadian heritage.

item.title: World Tourism Day 2025: Tourism and Sustainable Transformation | Visit Trinidad
item.description: World Tourism Day is observed annually across the globe on September 27. This year’s theme, “Tourism and Sustainable Transformation,” aligns perfectly with the Government of the Republic of Trinidad and Tobago’s (GoRTT) thrust to positioning tourism as a key pillar of economic growth and sustainable progress.

item.title: Things to do in Trinidad for March 27-30, 2026 Long Weekend
item.description: With Spiritual Baptist Liberation Day on Monday, Trinidad opens up for a three-day weekend that blends culture, food, and coastal escapes. Whether you’re staying close to the city or heading further out, the calendar is packed with guided tours, local experiences and easy ways to explore the island.
